items.english: ... so water soaks in instead of running off.
items.backtranslation: ... so water goes into the 'place of rolling'.
items.problem: Purpose of contour beds (water soaks in, no run-off) lost; replaced by an unclear phrase.
items.corrected: ... ukuze amanzi angene emhlabeni kunokuba abaleke.

items.english: Skip the edging. Reshape the beds by hand a few times a year.
items.draft: Yeka ukwenza imiphetho. Phinda uyilise iibhedi ngesandla ...
items.backtranslation: Stop making edges. Re-'uyilise' the beds by hand ... (unintelligible verb)
items.problem: 'uyilise' is not a recognisable verb for reshaping; the instruction is unclear.
items.corrected: Yeka ukwenza imiphetho. Phinda wenze iibhedi zibe nemo entsha ngesandla izihlandlo ezimbalwa ngonyaka.

items.english: On a still, cold evening, feel where the cold air settles.
items.draft: ... vakalisa ukuba umoya obandayo uhlala phi.
items.backtranslation: ... announce / make audible where the cold air settles.
items.problem: Wrong verb: 'vakalisa' means make heard/announce, not feel/notice.
items.corrected: ... va ukuba umoya obandayo uhlala phi.

items.where: Plan for the life you have, first sentence
items.english: A big garden you cannot look after soon becomes a weedy, wasted one.
items.draft: Igadi enkulu ongakwaziyo ukuyikhathalela ngokukhawuleza iba yigadi efunge ukhula, elahlekileyo.
items.backtranslation: A big garden that you cannot look after quickly becomes a weedy, lost one.
items.problem: 'Soon' attached to 'look after' (cannot look after quickly) instead of to 'becomes weedy'.
items.corrected: Igadi enkulu ongakwaziyo ukuyikhathalela iba yigadi efunge ukhula, elahlekileyo kungekudala.
